verdict.rationale: CoreWeave offers CKS, a managed Kubernetes service running on bare metal with autoscaling node pools, and SUNK, which runs Slurm jobs inside Kubernetes to share compute across training/inference workloads — directly delivering managed scheduling without building a custom scheduler on raw nodes. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of SUNK's Slurm scheduling at scale beyond first-party docs, and more detail on job-queueing/priority features typical of Slurm.
